func planCmd() *cobra.Command {
        cmd := &cobra.Command{Use: "plan", Short: "Drive the planner lease by hand"}
        var q api.PlanReq
        var ttl time.Duration
        var expected []string
        post := func(path string) func(*cobra.Command, []string) error {
                return func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        q.TTLMs = ttl.Milliseconds()
                        if len(expected) > 0 {
                                q.Expected = map[int]int{}
                                for _, kv := range expected {
                                        var tier, n int
                                        if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(strings.Replace(kv, "=", " ", 1), "%d %d", &tier, &n); err != nil {
                                                return fmt.Errorf("--expected %q: want TIER=COUNT", kv)
                                        }
                                        q.Expected[tier] = n
                                }
                        }
                        var out any
                        if err := c.Post(cmd.Context(), path, q, &out); err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        return printJSON(out)
                }
        }
        begin := &cobra.Command{Use: "begin", Short: "Take the planner lease", RunE: post("/v1/plan/begin")}
        begin.Flags().DurationVar(&ttl, "ttl", time.Minute, "lease length")
        update := &cobra.Command{Use: "update", Short: "Publish hints to waiting agents", RunE: post("/v1/plan/update")}
        update.Flags().Uint64Var(&q.Epoch, "epoch", 0, "planning epoch")
        update.Flags().DurationVar(&ttl, "ttl", time.Minute, "lease length")
        update.Flags().StringVar(&q.Phase, "phase", "", "what the planner is doing")
        update.Flags().StringArrayVar(&expected, "expected", nil, "tasks expected, as TIER=COUNT")
        update.Flags().Int64Var(&q.ETAMs, "eta-ms", 0, "estimated time to commit")
        commit := &cobra.Command{Use: "commit", Short: "Publish the plan", RunE: post("/v1/plan/commit")}
        commit.Flags().Uint64Var(&q.Epoch, "epoch", 0, "planning epoch")
        add := &cobra.Command{Use: "add", Short: "Add a draft task to the plan", RunE: post("/v1/plan/add")}
        add.Flags().Uint64Var(&q.Epoch, "epoch", 0, "planning epoch")
        add.Flags().StringVar(&q.Task.ID, "id", "", "task id; generated if empty")
        add.Flags().StringVar(&q.Task.Title, "title", "", "short title")
        add.Flags().StringVar(&q.Task.Spec, "spec", "", "full instructions")
        add.Flags().IntVar(&q.Task.Tier, "tier", 1, "tier: 1 standard, 2 advanced, 3 ultra")
        add.Flags().IntVar(&q.Task.Priority, "priority", 0, "higher runs sooner")
        add.Flags().StringSliceVar(&q.Task.Deps, "dep", nil, "task id this depends on")
        add.Flags().StringSliceVar(&q.Task.Tags, "tag", nil, "required capability tag")
        add.Flags().StringSliceVar(&q.Task.Touches, "touches", nil, "path this task will change")
        add.Flags().StringArrayVar(&q.Task.Checks, "check", nil, "acceptance command")
        add.Flags().BoolVar(&q.Task.RequireReview, "review", false, "also require an independent agent review")
        cmd.AddCommand(begin, update, add, commit)
        return cmd
}

package main

import (
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "os"
        "path/filepath"
        "strconv"
        "strings"

        "github.com/spf13/cobra"

        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/harness"
)

// target is one config file to change, with a label for messages.
type target struct {
        label string
        h     harness.Harness
        cli   []string
}

// resolveTargets accepts auto, all, harness ids, a path to a harness executable, or
// a path to a config file. An existing executable or a known basename means a
// harness; any other path means a config file.
func resolveTargets(arg, format string, global bool) ([]target, error) {
        var out []target
        addHarness := func(h harness.Harness) {
                t := target{label: h.ID, h: h, cli: h.CLIAdd}
                if global {
                        t.h.MCPFile = harness.ExpandHome(h.GlobalMCPFile)
                        t.cli = nil // The harness's own command would write to its project scope.
                        if h.GlobalMCPFile == "" {
                                t.h.MCP = harness.MCPNone
                                t.h.MCPFile = ""
                        }
                }
                out = append(out, t)
        }
        switch arg {
        case "", "auto", "installed", "detected":
                for _, h := range harness.Detected() {
                        addHarness(h)
                }
                if len(out) == 0 {
                        return nil, errors.New("no known harness found on PATH; name one with --harness")
                }
                return out, nil
        case "all":
                for _, h := range harness.All() {
                        addHarness(h)
                }
                return out, nil
        }
        for _, item := range strings.Split(arg, ",") {
                item = strings.TrimSpace(item)
                if h, ok := harness.Get(item); ok {
                        addHarness(h)
                        continue
                }
                if !strings.ContainsAny(item, `/\`) && !strings.Contains(item, ".") {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown harness %q: see aiculator harness, or give a path", item)
                }
                if h, ok := harnessForBinary(item); ok {
                        addHarness(h)
                        continue
                }
                abs, err := filepath.Abs(harness.ExpandHome(item))
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, err
                }
                f := harness.MCPFormat(format)
                if f == "" {
                        f = harness.FormatForPath(abs)
                }
                out = append(out, target{label: abs, h: harness.At(f, abs)})
        }
        return out, nil
}

// harnessForBinary recognizes a path to a harness's executable by its file name.
func harnessForBinary(path string) (harness.Harness, bool) {
        fi, err := os.Stat(harness.ExpandHome(path))
        if err != nil || fi.IsDir() || fi.Mode().Perm()&0o111 == 0 {
                return harness.Harness{}, false
        }
        base := strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(path), ".exe")
        for _, h := range harness.All() {
                for _, b := range h.Bins {
                        if b == base {
                                return h, true
                        }
                }
        }
        return harness.Harness{}, false
}

type mcpFlags struct {
        harnessArg, format, name string
        tier                     int
        planner, global, dry     bool
        env                      []string
}

func (f *mcpFlags) register(cmd *cobra.Command) {
        fl := cmd.Flags()
        fl.StringVar(&f.harnessArg, "harness", "auto", "auto, all, ids, a harness executable, or a config file path")
        fl.StringVar(&f.format, "format", "", "for a config path: mcpServers-json, opencode-json or codex-toml; inferred if empty")
        fl.StringVar(&f.name, "name", harness.ServerName, "server name")
        fl.IntVar(&f.tier, "tier", 1, "tier for the swarm's own server")
        fl.BoolVar(&f.planner, "planner", false, "allow the swarm's own server to plan")
        fl.BoolVar(&f.global, "global", false, "use the harness's user-level config")
        fl.StringArrayVar(&f.env, "env", nil, "environment variable for a custom server, as KEY=VALUE; stored in plain text")
}

// entry builds the server to register: the words after -- for a custom server,
// otherwise the swarm's bridge, which needs no secret in the file.
func (f *mcpFlags) entry(args []string, h harness.Harness) (harness.Entry, error) {
        env := map[string]string{}
        for _, kv := range f.env {
                k, v, ok := strings.Cut(kv, "=")
                if !ok || k == "" {
                        return harness.Entry{}, fmt.Errorf("--env %q: want KEY=VALUE", kv)
                }
                env[k] = v
        }
        if len(args) > 0 {
                if f.name == harness.ServerName {
                        return harness.Entry{}, errors.New("a custom server needs its own --name")
                }
                return harness.Entry{Name: f.name, Command: args[0], Args: args[1:], Env: env}, nil
        }
        if f.name != harness.ServerName {
                return harness.Entry{}, errors.New("--name is for a custom server: give its command after --")
        }
        bridge := []string{"mcp", "--auto", "--tier", strconv.Itoa(f.tier)}
        if f.planner {
                bridge = append(bridge, "--planner")
        }
        if h.ID != "" && h.ID != "custom" {
                bridge = append(bridge, "--harness", h.ID)
        }
        return harness.Entry{Command: selfCommand(), Args: bridge, Env: env}, nil
}

func mcpAddCmd() *cobra.Command {
        var f mcpFlags
        cmd := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "add [--harness TARGET] [--name NAME -- COMMAND ARGS...]",
                Short: "Add the swarm's MCP server, or any server, to a harness's config",
                Example: `  aiculator mcp add                               every installed harness
  aiculator mcp add --harness opencode --tier 2
  aiculator mcp add --harness claude,cursor --global
  aiculator mcp add --harness ~/.local/bin/opencode   found from the executable
  aiculator mcp add --harness ./custom/mcp.json       a config file; format inferred
  aiculator mcp add --name docs --harness claude -- npx -y docs-server`,
                RunE: func(_ *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        targets, err := resolveTargets(f.harnessArg, f.format, f.global)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        root := projectRoot()
                        backups := filepath.Join(dataDir, "backups")
                        if f.dry {
                                backups = ""
                        }
                        for _, t := range targets {
                                if t.h.MCP == harness.MCPNone {
                                        msg := "no config file that aiculator can write"
                                        if t.h.Source != "" && f.name == harness.ServerName {
                                                msg += "; it can join through the shell: aiculator work join"
                                        }
                                        fmt.Printf("%-10s skipped: %s\n", t.label, msg)
                                        continue
                                }
                                e, err := f.entry(args, t.h)
                                if err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                                if f.dry {
                                        fmt.Printf("# %s: would write to %s\n%s\n", t.label, t.h.MCPFile, t.h.Snippet(e))
                                        continue
                                }
                                r, err := t.h.WriteMCP(root, e, backups)
                                if err != nil {
                                        fmt.Printf("%-10s failed: %v\n", t.label, err)
                                        continue
                                }
                                state := "already set"
                                if r.Changed {
                                        state = "written"
                                }
                                fmt.Printf("%-10s %s: %s\n", t.label, state, r.Path)
                        }
                        return nil
                },
        }
        f.register(cmd)
        cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&f.dry, "dry-run", false, "show what would be written and change nothing")
        return cmd
}

func mcpPrintCmd() *cobra.Command {
        var f mcpFlags
        cmd := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "print [--harness TARGET] [--name NAME -- COMMAND ARGS...]",
                Short: "Print the config piece to add a server by hand; changes nothing",
                Example: `  aiculator mcp print --harness opencode
  aiculator mcp print --harness codex --planner
  aiculator mcp print --harness ./custom.toml
  aiculator mcp print --name docs --harness claude -- npx -y docs-server`,
                RunE: func(_ *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        targets, err := resolveTargets(f.harnessArg, f.format, f.global)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        for i, t := range targets {
                                if i > 0 {
                                        fmt.Println()
                                }
                                h := t.h
                                if h.MCP == harness.MCPNone {
                                        // No known file, but this shape is what most harnesses accept.
                                        fmt.Printf("# %s: no confirmed config file. This is the common shape; check its docs.\n", t.label)
                                        h.MCP = harness.MCPServersJSON
                                } else {
                                        fmt.Printf("# %s: add to %s\n", t.label, h.MCPFile)
                                }
                                e, err := f.entry(args, t.h)
                                if err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                                fmt.Print(h.Snippet(e))
                                if len(t.cli) > 0 {
                                        fmt.Printf("# Or with its own command:\n#   %s\n", shellJoin(append(append(append([]string{}, t.cli...), f.name, "--"), append([]string{e.Command}, e.Args...)...)))
                                }
                        }
                        return nil
                },
        }
        f.register(cmd)
        return cmd
}

func mcpRemoveCmd() *cobra.Command {
        var f mcpFlags
        cmd := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "remove [--harness TARGET] [--name NAME]",
                Short: "Remove a server from a harness's config, and nothing else",
                RunE: func(*cobra.Command, []string) error {
                        targets, err := resolveTargets(f.harnessArg, f.format, f.global)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        root := projectRoot()
                        for _, t := range targets {
                                r, err := t.h.RemoveNamed(root, f.name, filepath.Join(dataDir, "backups"))
                                if err != nil {
                                        fmt.Printf("%-10s failed: %v\n", t.label, err)
                                        continue
                                }
                                if r.Changed {
                                        fmt.Printf("%-10s removed from %s\n", t.label, r.Path)
                                }
                        }
                        return nil
                },
        }
        f.register(cmd)
        return cmd
}

func shellJoin(words []string) string {
        out := make([]string, len(words))
        for i, w := range words {
                if w == "" || strings.ContainsAny(w, " \t'\"$`\\*?") {
                        out[i] = "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(w, "'", `'\''`) + "'"
                } else {
                        out[i] = w
                }
        }
        return strings.Join(out, " ")
}

package main

import (
        "encoding/json"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "mime"
        "net/url"
        "os"
        "path/filepath"
        "strings"

        "github.com/spf13/cobra"

        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/meta"
)

func metaCmds() []*cobra.Command {
        show := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "meta ID",
                Short: "Show a task's properties, files and foreign resources",
                Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(1),
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        var m meta.Meta
                        if err := c.Get(cmd.Context(), "/v1/tasks/"+args[0]+"/meta", &m); err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        return printJSON(m)
                },
        }
        prop := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "prop ID NAME=VALUE...",
                Short: "Set properties; JSON values keep their type, and NAME= removes one",
                Args:  cobra.MinimumNArgs(2),
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        p := meta.Patch{Props: map[string]*meta.Prop{}}
                        for _, a := range args[1:] {
                                k, v, ok := strings.Cut(a, "=")
                                if !ok {
                                        return fmt.Errorf("%q: use NAME=VALUE", a)
                                }
                                if v == "" {
                                        p.Props[k] = nil
                                        continue
                                }
                                var val any
                                if json.Unmarshal([]byte(v), &val) != nil {
                                        val = v
                                }
                                p.Props[k] = &meta.Prop{Value: val}
                        }
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        return c.Post(cmd.Context(), "/v1/tasks/"+args[0]+"/meta", p, nil)
                },
        }
        var attachName string
        attach := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "attach ID FILE",
                Short: "Store a file as a blob and attach it to a task",
                Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(2),
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        f, err := os.Open(args[1])
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        defer f.Close()
                        base := filepath.Base(args[1])
                        mediaType := mime.TypeByExtension(filepath.Ext(base))
                        if mediaType == "" {
                                mediaType = "application/octet-stream"
                        }
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        var ref meta.BlobRef
                        if err := c.Upload(cmd.Context(), "/v1/blobs?name="+url.QueryEscape(base), mediaType, f, &ref); err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        name := attachName
                        if name == "" {
                                name = base
                        }
                        p := meta.Patch{Props: map[string]*meta.Prop{name: {Blob: &ref}}}
                        if err := c.Post(cmd.Context(), "/v1/tasks/"+args[0]+"/meta", p, nil); err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        fmt.Println(name, ref.SHA256)
                        return nil
                },
        }
        attach.Flags().StringVar(&attachName, "name", "", "property name; the file name if empty")
        var kind string
        resource := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "resource ID NAME URL",
                Short: "Attach a foreign object by reference; its bytes are fetched only when asked for",
                Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(3),
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        p := meta.Patch{Props: map[string]*meta.Prop{args[1]: {Resource: &meta.Resource{Kind: kind, URL: args[2], Name: args[1]}}}}
                        return c.Post(cmd.Context(), "/v1/tasks/"+args[0]+"/meta", p, nil)
                },
        }
        resource.Flags().StringVar(&kind, "kind", "http", "what kind of object this is")
        var output string
        fetch := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "fetch ID NAME",
                Short: "Save an attached file or foreign resource; a resource is downloaded only once",
                Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(2),
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        var m meta.Meta
                        if err := c.Get(cmd.Context(), "/v1/tasks/"+args[0]+"/meta", &m); err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        p, ok := m.Props[args[1]]
                        if !ok {
                                return fmt.Errorf("%s has no property %s", args[0], args[1])
                        }
                        var ref meta.BlobRef
                        switch {
                        case p.Blob != nil:
                                ref = *p.Blob
                        case p.Resource != nil:
                                if err := c.Post(cmd.Context(), "/v1/tasks/"+args[0]+"/resources/"+args[1], nil, &ref); err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                        default:
                                return fmt.Errorf("%s is a plain value: see task meta", args[1])
                        }
                        body, err := c.Download(cmd.Context(), "/v1/blobs/"+ref.SHA256)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        defer body.Close()
                        out := io.Writer(os.Stdout)
                        if output != "" {
                                f, err := os.Create(output)
                                if err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                                defer f.Close()
                                out = f
                        }
                        _, err = io.Copy(out, body)
                        return err
                },
        }
        fetch.Flags().StringVarP(&output, "output", "o", "", "file to write; standard output if empty")
        return []*cobra.Command{show, prop, attach, resource, fetch}
}

package main

import (
        "bytes"
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "os"
        "strings"

        "github.com/spf13/cobra"
        "go.yaml.in/yaml/v3"

        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/parallel"
)

func parallelCmd() *cobra.Command {
        cmd := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "parallel",
                Short: "Work out what subagents can do at the same time in one working tree",
                Long: `Worktrees keep tasks apart. This is the level below: one task split among subagents in one
checkout. Give it the jobs and what each will change, and it says what can safely run at once.
Jobs share a wave only if their claims cannot overlap, and a job that claims nothing runs alone.

This needs no server, and it does not touch the swarm's state.`,
        }
        var (
                file, level, output string
                maxJobs             int
                asJSON              bool
        )
        plan := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "plan",
                Short: "Plan jobs into waves that cannot conflict",
                Long: `Reads jobs as YAML or JSON. A claim is a file or a directory ending in /. With symbol
granularity it can also be file#symbol or file:10-40. Reads are what a job relies on staying the same while it works.

Granularity is how finely claims are compared. The default, auto, uses the coarser of dir and
file that loses no parallelism, and it treats file#symbol as the whole file. To let two jobs share
one file, ask for symbol. Their claims are then checked against the file, but nothing can stop a
subagent straying, and two in one file can overwrite each other.`,
                Example: `  aiculator parallel plan --file jobs.yaml -o plan.json
  cat jobs.yaml | aiculator parallel plan --file - --max 3

  # jobs.yaml
  jobs:
    - id: api
      touches: [internal/api/users.go]
    - id: docs
      touches: [docs/users.md]
      reads: [internal/api/users.go]
    - id: format
      exclusive: true
      deps: [api, docs]`,
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
                        if file == "" {
                                return errors.New("give the jobs with --file jobs.yaml, or --file - for standard input")
                        }
                        var data []byte
                        var err error
                        if file == "-" {
                                data, err = io.ReadAll(os.Stdin)
                        } else {
                                data, err = os.ReadFile(file)
                        }
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        var in parallel.Input
                        dec := yaml.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
                        dec.KnownFields(true)
                        if err := dec.Decode(&in); err != nil {
                                return fmt.Errorf("reading the jobs: %w", err)
                        }
                        if cmd.Flags().Changed("granularity") || in.Granularity == "" {
                                in.Granularity = parallel.Granularity(level)
                        }
                        if cmd.Flags().Changed("max") || in.Max == 0 {
                                in.Max = maxJobs
                        }
                        if in.Granularity == parallel.Symbol {
                                if err := parallel.CheckClaims(projectRoot(), in.Jobs); err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                        }
                        p, err := parallel.Schedule(in)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        b, err := json.MarshalIndent(p, "", "  ")
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        if output != "" {
                                if err := writeFileAtomic(output, append(b, '\n')); err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                        }
                        if asJSON {
                                fmt.Println(string(b))
                                return nil
                        }
                        printPlanWaves(p, output)
                        return nil
                },
        }
        pf := plan.Flags()
        pf.StringVar(&file, "file", "", "the jobs, as YAML or JSON; - for standard input")
        pf.StringVar(&level, "granularity", "auto", "dir, file, symbol, repo or auto")
        pf.IntVar(&maxJobs, "max", 4, "most subagents at once")
        pf.StringVarP(&output, "output", "o", "", "save the plan, for verify")
        pf.BoolVar(&asJSON, "json", false, "print the plan as JSON")

        snapshot := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "snapshot",
                Short: "Record the working tree before a wave, without staging or committing anything",
                RunE: func(*cobra.Command, []string) error {
                        tree, err := parallel.Snapshot(projectRoot())
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        fmt.Println(tree)
                        return nil
                },
        }
        var (
                planFile, since string
                wave            int
        )
        verify := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "verify",
                Short: "Check that a wave changed only what its jobs claimed; exits 1 if not",
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
                        b, err := os.ReadFile(planFile)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        var p parallel.Plan
                        if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &p); err != nil {
                                return fmt.Errorf("reading the plan: %w", err)
                        }
                        r, err := parallel.Verify(projectRoot(), &p, wave, since)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        if asJSON {
                                if err := printJSON(r); err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                        } else {
                                fmt.Printf("%d files changed in wave %d.\n", len(r.Changed), wave)
                                for _, f := range r.Unclaimed {
                                        fmt.Printf("  NOT CLAIMED: %s\n", f)
                                }
                                if len(r.Idle) > 0 {
                                        fmt.Printf("  Changed nothing, so check that these did their work: %s\n", strings.Join(r.Idle, ", "))
                                }
                                fmt.Println(r.Note)
                        }
                        if !r.OK {
                                return fmt.Errorf("wave %d changed %d files that no job claimed", wave, len(r.Unclaimed))
                        }
                        return nil
                },
        }
        vf := verify.Flags()
        vf.StringVar(&planFile, "plan", "", "the plan saved by parallel plan -o")
        vf.IntVar(&wave, "wave", 1, "which wave just finished")
        vf.StringVar(&since, "since", "", "what parallel snapshot printed before that wave")
        vf.BoolVar(&asJSON, "json", false, "print as JSON")
        _ = verify.MarkFlagRequired("plan")
        _ = verify.MarkFlagRequired("since")
        cmd.AddCommand(plan, snapshot, verify)
        return cmd
}

func printPlanWaves(p *parallel.Plan, saved string) {
        jobs := 0
        for _, w := range p.Waves {
                jobs += len(w.Jobs)
        }
        if p.Verdict == "parallel" {
                fmt.Printf("Parallel: %d jobs in %d waves, compared at %s level.\n", jobs, len(p.Waves), p.Granularity)
        } else {
                fmt.Printf("Sequential: these %d jobs cannot safely run together, even at %s level.\n", jobs, p.Granularity)
        }
        for _, w := range p.Waves {
                fmt.Printf("  Wave %d: %s\n", w.N, strings.Join(w.Jobs, ", "))
        }
        if !p.Optimal {
                fmt.Println("This schedule is good, but with this many jobs it is not proven to be the shortest.")
        }
        if len(p.Alone) > 0 {
                fmt.Printf("Running alone, because they claim nothing or asked to: %s\n", strings.Join(p.Alone, ", "))
        }
        for _, c := range p.Conflicts {
                if strings.HasSuffix(c.Why, "must run alone") {
                        continue // Already said above, and it would be a line for every other job.
                }
                fmt.Printf("  %s and %s: %s\n", c.A, c.B, c.Why)
        }
        if saved != "" {
                fmt.Printf("Saved to %s.\n", saved)
        }
}

import (
        "context"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "log/slog"
        "net/http"
        "os"
        "os/exec"
        "path/filepath"
        "slices"
        "strings"
        "text/tabwriter"
        "time"

        "github.com/spf13/cobra"

        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/api"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/core"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/realm"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/pkg/observe"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/pkg/plugin"
)

// startPlugins runs the compiled-in plugins inside the server.
func startPlugins(ctx context.Context, srv *api.Server, mux *http.ServeMux, log *slog.Logger) (func(), error) {
        m := plugin.Start(plugin.All(), plugin.Config{
                Router:  mux,
                Guard:   srv.ViewerOnly,
                Version: version,
                Log:     log,
                Snapshot: func(ctx context.Context) (observe.Snapshot, error) {
                        return srv.S.Snapshot(ctx, version)
                },
        })
        mux.Handle("GET /v1/plugins", srv.ViewerOnly(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
                api.WriteJSON(w, m.Statuses())
        })))
        tailCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
        done := make(chan struct{})
        go func() {
                defer close(done)
                err := srv.S.Store.TailEvents(tailCtx, func(t core.Task) {
                        m.Publish(plugin.Event{TaskID: t.ID, Title: t.Title, State: string(t.State), Tier: t.Tier, Owner: t.Owner, Reason: t.Reason, Time: t.UpdatedAt})
                })
                if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
                        log.Error("plugin event stream stopped", "err", err)
                }
        }()
        return func() {
                cancel()
                <-done
                m.Stop()
        }, nil
}

// pluginCLI gives plugin commands what they need, without handing them the admin token.
func pluginCLI() *plugin.CLI {
        return &plugin.CLI{
                ViewerToken: func(ctx context.Context, ttl time.Duration) (string, string, error) {
                        name := "viewer-" + randomSuffix()
                        url, tok, err := issueLocal(ctx, api.TokenReq{Agent: name, Viewer: true, TTLSec: int64(ttl.Seconds())})
                        return url, tok, err
                },
                Snapshot: func(ctx context.Context) (observe.Snapshot, error) {
                        var s observe.Snapshot
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return s, fmt.Errorf("%w; start it with: aiculator up", err)
                        }
                        return s, c.Get(ctx, "/v1/observe", &s)
                },
                Fleet: func(ctx context.Context, ttl time.Duration) (any, error) {
                        return fleetWithLinks(ctx, int64(ttl.Seconds()))
                },
                Analytics: func(ctx context.Context, name, query string) (observe.Analytics, error) {
                        var a observe.Analytics
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if name != "" {
                                r, gerr := realm.Get(name)
                                if gerr != nil {
                                        return a, gerr
                                }
                                c, err = realm.Local(r)
                        }
                        if err != nil {
                                return a, err
                        }
                        path := "/v1/analytics"
                        if query != "" {
                                path += "?" + query
                        }
                        return a, c.Get(ctx, path, &a)
                },
        }
}

func addPluginCommands(root *cobra.Command) {
        cli := pluginCLI()
        for _, p := range plugin.All() {
                c, ok := p.(plugin.Commander)
                if !ok {
                        continue
                }
                for _, sub := range c.Commands(cli) {
                        if _, _, err := root.Find([]string{sub.Name()}); err == nil && sub.Name() != "" && commandExists(root, sub.Name()) {
                                fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "plugin %s: command %q is already taken, so it was skipped\n", p.Name(), sub.Name())
                                continue
                        }
                        root.AddCommand(sub)
                }
        }
}

func commandExists(root *cobra.Command, name string) bool {
        return slices.ContainsFunc(root.Commands(), func(c *cobra.Command) bool { return c.Name() == name || c.HasAlias(name) })
}

const externalPrefix = "aiculator-"

// externalPlugins lists programs on PATH that work as commands.
func externalPlugins() map[string]string {
        out := map[string]string{}
        for _, dir := range filepath.SplitList(os.Getenv("PATH")) {
                entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
                if err != nil {
                        continue
                }
                for _, e := range entries {
                        name, ok := strings.CutPrefix(e.Name(), externalPrefix)
                        name = strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".exe")
                        if !ok || name == "" {
                                continue
                        }
                        path := filepath.Join(dir, e.Name())
                        fi, err := os.Stat(path)
                        if err != nil || fi.IsDir() || fi.Mode().Perm()&0o111 == 0 {
                                continue
                        }
                        if _, seen := out[name]; !seen { // PATH order decides, as it does for any command.
                                out[name] = path
                        }
                }
        }
        return out
}

// runExternal runs aiculator-NAME when NAME is not a built-in command. Built-ins always
// win, so a program on PATH can never replace one. Only PATH is searched, never the
// project, so cloning a repository cannot add a command.
func runExternal(root *cobra.Command, args []string) (handled bool, code int) {
        if len(args) == 0 || strings.HasPrefix(args[0], "-") || args[0] == "help" || commandExists(root, args[0]) {
                return false, 0
        }
        path, err := exec.LookPath(externalPrefix + args[0])
        if err != nil {
                return false, 0
        }
        cmd := exec.Command(path, args[1:]...)
        cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
        data, _ := filepath.Abs(findDataDir())
        cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "AICULATOR_DATA="+data, "AICULATOR_VERSION="+version, "AICULATOR_V="+os.Getenv("AICULATOR_V"))
        if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
                var ee *exec.ExitError
                if errors.As(err, &ee) {
                        return true, ee.ExitCode()
                }
                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
                return true, 1
        }
        return true, 0
}

func pluginCmd() *cobra.Command {
        cmd := &cobra.Command{
                Use:     "plugin",
                Aliases: []string{"plugins"},
                Short:   "List plugins, both compiled in and on PATH",
                Long: `Plugins compiled into this binary add commands, server routes and event handlers.
Build one in with a blank import in cmd/aiculator; the web dashboard is one, and go build
-tags noweb leaves it out.

Any program on PATH named aiculator-NAME also runs as aiculator NAME.`,
                RunE: func(*cobra.Command, []string) error {
                        w := tabwriter.NewWriter(os.Stdout, 0, 0, 2, ' ', 0)
                        fmt.Fprintln(w, "NAME\tKIND\tDESCRIPTION")
                        for _, p := range plugin.All() {
                                fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s\tcompiled in\t%s\n", p.Name(), p.Description())
                        }
                        ext := externalPlugins()
                        names := make([]string, 0, len(ext))
                        for n := range ext {
                                names = append(names, n)
                        }
                        slices.Sort(names)
                        for _, n := range names {
                                fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s\ton PATH\t%s\n", n, ext[n])
                        }
                        return w.Flush()
                },
        }
        return cmd
}

package main

import (
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "os"
        "os/exec"
        "path/filepath"
        "syscall"
)

func detach(cmd *exec.Cmd) { cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setsid: true} }

func stopProcess(pid int) error { return syscall.Kill(pid, syscall.SIGTERM) }

// processAlive reports whether a process exists. EPERM means it exists under another user.
func processAlive(pid int) bool {
        err := syscall.Kill(pid, 0)
        return err == nil || errors.Is(err, syscall.EPERM)
}

// lockDataDir holds an exclusive lock for as long as the process runs. The kernel releases
// it however the process ends, so a crash cannot leave a stale lock.
func lockDataDir(dir string) (func(), error) {
        f, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(dir, "lock"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }
        if err := syscall.Flock(int(f.Fd()), syscall.LOCK_EX|syscall.LOCK_NB); err != nil {
                _ = f.Close()
                if errors.Is(err, syscall.EWOULDBLOCK) {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("another server is already using %s", dir)
                }
                return nil, err
        }
        return func() { _ = f.Close() }, nil
}

package main

import (
        "context"
        "fmt"
        "log/slog"

        "github.com/spf13/cobra"

        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/tui"
)

type realmIdentity struct{ name, path, instance string }

// registerRealm adds this project to the machine's directory. The swarm works without it,
// so a failure here is only logged.
func registerRealm(log *slog.Logger) realmIdentity {
        abs, err := filepath.Abs(dataDir)
        if err != nil {
                return realmIdentity{}
        }
        id := realmIdentity{path: filepath.Dir(abs), instance: realm.Instance(abs), name: filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(abs))}
        r, err := realm.Register(id.path, abs)
        if err != nil {
                log.Warn("this project was not added to the realm directory", "err", err)
                return id
        }
        id.name = r.Name
        return id
}

// fleet reads every realm for the dashboards.
func fleet(ctx context.Context) ([]tui.FleetRow, error) {
        views, err := realm.Gather(ctx, nil)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }
        out := make([]tui.FleetRow, len(views))
        for i, v := range views {
                out[i] = tui.FleetRow{Name: v.Realm.Name, Path: v.Realm.Path, Live: v.Live, Missing: v.Missing}
                if v.Snapshot != nil {
                        out[i].Snapshot = *v.Snapshot
                }
        }
        return out, nil
}

// fleetWithLinks also makes a read-only link to each running realm's own dashboard.
func fleetWithLinks(ctx context.Context, ttlSec int64) ([]realm.View, error) {
        return realm.Gather(ctx, func(c context.Context, r realm.Realm, v *realm.View) {
                cl, err := realm.Local(r)
                if err != nil {
                        return
                }
                var out map[string]string
                q := api.TokenReq{Agent: "viewer-" + randomSuffix(), Viewer: true, TTLSec: ttlSec}
                if cl.Post(c, "/v1/tokens", q, &out) == nil && out["token"] != "" {
                        v.Link = cl.URL + "/plugins/webdash/#token=" + out["token"]
                }
        })
}

func realmCmd() *cobra.Command {
        var asJSON bool
        cmd := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "realm",
                Short: "See and name the projects on this machine that use the swarm",
                Long: `A realm is one project, with its own server and its own store. A project becomes one
when its server starts. Realms never share tasks or tokens, so trouble in one stays there.

Act on one from any folder with --realm NAME, such as: aiculator --realm shop task ls
See them all with: aiculator top --all, or aiculator web --all`,
        }
        ls := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "ls",
                Short: "List the realms, and which are running",
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
                        views, err := realm.Gather(cmd.Context(), nil)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        if asJSON {
                                for i := range views {
                                        views[i].Snapshot = nil
                                }
                                return printJSON(views)
                        }
                        if len(views) == 0 {
                                fmt.Println("No realms yet. A project becomes one when its server starts: aiculator join")
                                return nil
                        }
                        abs, _ := filepath.Abs(dataDir)
                        fmt.Printf("  %-24s %-9s %s\n", "NAME", "STATE", "PATH")
                        for _, v := range views {
                                state := "stopped"
                                switch {
                                case v.Missing:
                                        state = "missing"
                                case v.Live:
                                        state = "running"
                                }
                                mark := " "
                                if v.Realm.DataDir == abs {
                                        mark = "*"
                                }
                                fmt.Printf("%s %-24s %-9s %s\n", mark, v.Realm.Name, state, v.Realm.Path)
                        }
                        return nil
                },
        }
        ls.Flags().BoolVar(&asJSON, "json", false, "print as JSON")
        rename := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "rename OLD NEW",
                Short: "Give a realm a new name",
                Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(2),
                RunE: func(_ *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        return realm.Rename(args[0], args[1])
                },
        }
        forget := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "forget NAME",
                Short: "Take a realm off the list; the project and its data are not touched",
                Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(1),
                RunE: func(_ *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        return realm.Forget(args[0])
                },
        }
        cmd.AddCommand(ls, rename, forget)
        return cmd
}

package main

import (
        "context"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "log/slog"
        "os"
        "path/filepath"
        "slices"

        "github.com/spf13/cobra"

        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/api"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/connect"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/swarm"
)

func loadSources(path string) (*connect.Config, error) {
        if path != "" {
                abs, err := filepath.Abs(path)
                if err != nil {
                        return nil, err
                }
                return connect.Load(abs, filepath.Dir(abs))
        }
        return connect.Find(projectRoot())
}

// startSync reads the sources file and starts whatever has a sync section. It returns nil
// when there is nothing to do.
func startSync(ctx context.Context, svc *swarm.Service, repo string, log *slog.Logger) *connect.Syncer {
        root := repo
        if root == "" {
                root = projectRoot()
        }
        cfg, err := connect.Find(root)
        if err != nil {
                if !errors.Is(err, connect.ErrNoConfig) {
                        log.Error("connectors are off: the sources file has a problem", "err", err)
                }
                return nil
        }
        svc.Connections = cfg.Downloaders()
        return connect.Start(ctx, cfg, svc, connect.Options{})
}

func syncCmd() *cobra.Command {
        cmd := &cobra.Command{Use: "sync", Short: "See how connected systems are being kept in step"}
        status := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "status",
                Short: "Show each source's sync: what was sent and received, latency and errors",
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        var st []connect.Status
                        if err := c.Get(cmd.Context(), "/v1/sync", &st); err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        if len(st) == 0 {
                                fmt.Println("no source has a sync section")
                                return nil
                        }
                        return printJSON(st)
                },
        }
        token := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "hook-token SOURCE",
                Short: "Show the token Notion sent when its webhook was set up",
                Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(1),
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        var out map[string]string
                        if err := c.Get(cmd.Context(), "/v1/sync/"+args[0]+"/hook-token", &out); err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        if out["token"] == "" {
                                return errors.New("no token has arrived yet")
                        }
                        fmt.Println(out["token"])
                        return nil
                },
        }
        cmd.AddCommand(status, token)
        return cmd
}

func importCmd() *cobra.Command {
        var (
                config, query string
                limit         int
                dryRun        bool
                update        bool
        )
        cmd := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "import SOURCE",
                Short: "Load tasks once from a configured source, such as Jira, Notion or a spreadsheet",
                Long: "Reads a source named in .agents/sources.yaml, once, and creates a task for each item.\n" +
                        "Importing again is safe: an item that was imported before is left alone, or brought up to date with --update.",
                Args: cobra.ExactArgs(1),
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        cfg, err := loadSources(config)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        src, err := cfg.Get(args[0])
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        conn, err := cfg.Open(src)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        rep, err := connect.Read(cmd.Context(), conn, src, connect.ImportOptions{Query: query, Limit: limit})
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        for _, f := range rep.Failed {
                                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "skipped:", f)
                        }
                        for _, id := range rep.Cyclic {
                                fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "skipped: in a dependency cycle:", id)
                        }
                        if dryRun {
                                fmt.Printf("%-32s %-4s %-8s %s\n", "ID", "TIER", "PRIORITY", "TITLE")
                                for _, m := range rep.Mapped {
                                        fmt.Printf("%-32s %-4d %-8d %s\n", m.Spec.ID, max(m.Spec.Tier, 1), m.Spec.Priority, m.Spec.Title)
                                }
                                fmt.Printf("%d read, %d would import, %d skipped by rules, %d could not be read. Nothing was changed.\n",
                                        rep.Read, len(rep.Mapped), rep.Skipped, len(rep.Failed)+len(rep.Cyclic))
                                return nil
                        }
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        items := make([]swarm.ImportItem, 0, len(rep.Mapped))
                        for _, m := range rep.Mapped {
                                items = append(items, swarm.ImportItem{Spec: m.Spec, Props: m.Props, Link: m.Link})
                        }
                        counts := map[string]int{}
                        failed := 0
                        // Requests stay small, and each one holds the server's writer only briefly.
                        for batch := range slices.Chunk(items, 256) {
                                var res []swarm.ImportResult
                                if err := c.Post(cmd.Context(), "/v1/import", api.ImportReq{Items: batch, Update: update}, &res); err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                                for _, r := range res {
                                        counts[r.Action]++
                                        if r.Error != "" {
                                                failed++
                                                fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "failed: %s: %s\n", r.ID, r.Error)
                                        }
                                        if r.Warning != "" {
                                                fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "warning: %s: %s\n", r.ID, r.Warning)
                                        }
                                }
                        }
                        fmt.Printf("%d read, %d created, %d updated, %d unchanged, %d skipped by rules, %d failed\n",
                                rep.Read, counts["created"], counts["updated"], counts["unchanged"], rep.Skipped, failed+len(rep.Failed)+len(rep.Cyclic))
                        if failed > 0 {
                                return fmt.Errorf("%d items failed", failed)
                        }
                        return nil
                },
        }
        f := cmd.Flags()
        f.StringVar(&config, "config", "", "sources file; .agents/sources.yaml if empty")
        f.StringVar(&query, "query", "", "use this query instead of the configured one: JQL for Jira, a JSON filter for Notion")
        f.IntVar(&limit, "limit", 0, "stop after this many items; 0 means all")
        f.BoolVar(&dryRun, "dry-run", false, "show what would be imported, and change nothing")
        f.BoolVar(&update, "update", false, "bring items that were imported before up to date")
        return cmd
}

func sourceCmd() *cobra.Command {
        var config string
        cmd := &cobra.Command{Use: "source", Short: "List and check the configured sources"}
        cmd.PersistentFlags().StringVar(&config, "config", "", "sources file; .agents/sources.yaml if empty")
        ls := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "ls",
                Short: "List the configured sources",
                RunE: func(*cobra.Command, []string) error {
                        cfg, err := loadSources(config)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        fmt.Printf("%-20s %-8s %s\n", "NAME", "KIND", "SYNC")
                        for _, s := range cfg.Sources {
                                fmt.Printf("%-20s %-8s %s\n", s.Name, s.Kind, s.SyncSummary())
                        }
                        return nil
                },
        }
        check := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "check NAME",
                Short: "Check a source's settings and credentials by reading from it",
                Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(1),
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        cfg, err := loadSources(config)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        src, err := cfg.Get(args[0])
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        conn, err := cfg.Open(src)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        rep, err := connect.Read(cmd.Context(), conn, src, connect.ImportOptions{Limit: 5})
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        fmt.Printf("%s: reachable. Read %d items; %d would map, %d could not be read.\n", src.Name, rep.Read, len(rep.Mapped), len(rep.Failed))
                        for _, m := range rep.Mapped {
                                fmt.Printf("  %s: %s\n", m.Spec.ID, m.Spec.Title)
                        }
                        for _, f := range rep.Failed {
                                fmt.Println("  problem:", f)
                        }
                        return nil
                },
        }
        cmd.AddCommand(ls, check)
        return cmd
}

package main

import (
        "fmt"
        "maps"
        "slices"
        "strings"

        "github.com/spf13/cobra"

        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/core"
)

// parseLabels reads k=v pairs. An empty value removes the label when amending.
func parseLabels(items []string) (map[string]string, error) {
        if len(items) == 0 {
                return nil, nil
        }
        out := map[string]string{}
        for _, it := range items {
                k, v, ok := strings.Cut(it, "=")
                if !ok || k == "" {
                        return nil, fmt.Errorf("label %q: use name=value", it)
                }
                out[k] = v
        }
        return out, nil
}

func amendCmd() *cobra.Command {
        var (
                title, spec   string
                priority      int
                labels, aging []string
        )
        cmd := &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "amend ID",
                Short: "Change a task's title, spec, priority, labels or aging, without touching its progress",
                Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(1),
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        var a core.Amendment
                        f := cmd.Flags()
                        if f.Changed("title") {
                                a.Title = &title
                        }
                        if f.Changed("spec") {
                                a.Spec = &spec
                        }
                        if f.Changed("priority") {
                                a.Priority = &priority
                        }
                        var err error
                        if a.Labels, err = parseLabels(labels); err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        if f.Changed("aging") {
                                steps, err := core.ParseAging(aging)
                                if err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                                a.Aging = &steps
                        }
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        var t core.Task
                        if err := c.Post(cmd.Context(), "/v1/tasks/"+args[0]+"/amend", a, &t); err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        fmt.Printf("%s: %s, priority %d", t.ID, t.Title, t.Priority)
                        if keys := slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(t.Labels)); len(keys) > 0 {
                                fmt.Printf(", labels %s", strings.Join(keys, " "))
                        }
                        fmt.Println()
                        return nil
                },
        }
        f := cmd.Flags()
        f.StringVar(&title, "title", "", "new title")
        f.StringVar(&spec, "spec", "", "new instructions")
        f.IntVar(&priority, "priority", 0, "new priority")
        f.StringArrayVar(&labels, "label", nil, "label as name=value; name= removes it")
        f.StringSliceVar(&aging, "aging", nil, "replace the aging steps, as wait=boost, such as 1h=5")
        return cmd
}

func priorityCmd() *cobra.Command {
        return &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "priority ID",
                Short: "Show how a task's priority is worked out right now",
                Args:  cobra.ExactArgs(1),
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        var v any
                        if err := c.Get(cmd.Context(), "/v1/tasks/"+args[0]+"/priority", &v); err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        return printJSON(v)
                },
        }
}

package main

import (
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "os"
        "strings"
        "text/tabwriter"

        "github.com/spf13/cobra"

        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/harness"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/skillpack"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/tmpl"
)

func templateCmd() *cobra.Command {
        var (
                install                         []string
                renderName, newName, harnessArg string
                forHarness                      string
                set, paths, sources             []string
                list, check, global, copyIt     bool
                perHarness, force               bool
        )
        cmd := &cobra.Command{
                Use:     "template [--install PATTERN...]",
                Aliases: []string{"templates"},
                Short:   "Render reusable instruction templates into skills",
                Long: `Templates live in .agents/templates; .agent/templates and .agent/template also work.
They use Jinja2 and MDX-style components, and render into skills that install exactly as
aiculator skill --install does.

Bundled components: Directive, Anchor, Subagents, Backoff, OutputFormat, Flow, Step, Note, Toc.
Add or replace one by creating components/NAME.md in a template directory.

These produce instructions for a model. A model can still ignore text, so anything that
must hold needs a real check, such as a task's --check command.`,
                Example: `  aiculator template --list
  aiculator template --new my-rules
  aiculator template --render agent-discipline --set retries=5
  aiculator template --install '*'
  aiculator template --install 'agent-*' --global --set timeout=300s
  aiculator template --install x --per-harness       a separate copy per harness
  aiculator template --install x --path ./vendor/skills --harness none
  aiculator template --check                         fail if a rendered skill is stale`,
                Args: cobra.ArbitraryArgs,
                RunE: func(c *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
                        root := projectRoot()
                        vars := map[string]string{}
                        for _, kv := range set {
                                k, v, ok := strings.Cut(kv, "=")
                                if !ok || k == "" {
                                        return fmt.Errorf("--set %q: want KEY=VALUE", kv)
                                }
                                vars[k] = v
                        }
                        var hs []harness.Harness
                        if harnessArg != "none" {
                                var err error
                                if hs, err = selectHarnesses(harnessArg); err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                        }
                        o := skillpack.Options{Root: root, Global: global, Harnesses: hs, Paths: paths, Copy: copyIt, Force: force}
                        s := tmpl.NewSet(o.Base(), sources)
                        io := tmpl.InstallOptions{Skill: o, Vars: vars, Version: version, PerHarness: perHarness}
                        wd, _ := os.Getwd()
                        switch {
                        case c.Flags().Changed("install"):
                                io.Skill.Patterns = skillpack.NormalizeShellStar(append(install, args...), wd)
                                acts, err := s.Install(io)
                                printActions(acts)
                                return err
                        case renderName != "":
                                t, err := s.Get(renderName)
                                if err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                                ctx := tmpl.Context{Vars: vars, Version: version}
                                if forHarness != "" {
                                        h, ok := harness.Get(forHarness)
                                        if !ok {
                                                return fmt.Errorf("unknown harness %q", forHarness)
                                        }
                                        ctx.Harness = &h
                                }
                                out, err := s.Render(t, ctx)
                                if err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                                fmt.Print(out)
                                return nil
                        case newName != "":
                                path, err := tmpl.New(o.Base(), newName)
                                if err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                                fmt.Printf("Created %s. Edit it, then run: aiculator template --install %s\n", path, newName)
                                return nil
                        case check:
                                io.Skill.Patterns = []string{"*"}
                                stale, err := s.Check(io)
                                if err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                                if len(stale) > 0 {
                                        return fmt.Errorf("out of date, run aiculator template --install: %s", strings.Join(stale, ", "))
                                }
                                fmt.Println("all rendered skills are up to date")
                                return nil
                        case list, len(args) == 0:
                                all, err := s.List()
                                if err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                                w := tabwriter.NewWriter(os.Stdout, 0, 0, 2, ' ', 0)
                                fmt.Fprintln(w, "TEMPLATE\tSOURCE")
                                for _, t := range all {
                                        fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s\t%s\n", t.Name, t.Source)
                                }
                                return w.Flush()
                        }
                        return errors.New("nothing to do: see aiculator template --help")
                },
        }
        f := cmd.Flags()
        f.StringSliceVar(&install, "install", nil, "render and install templates matching these patterns")
        f.StringVar(&renderName, "render", "", "print one rendered template; writes nothing")
        f.StringVar(&forHarness, "for", "", "with --render, render as this harness")
        f.StringVar(&newName, "new", "", "create a starter template")
        f.BoolVar(&list, "list", false, "list templates")
        f.BoolVar(&check, "check", false, "fail if a rendered skill no longer matches its template")
        f.StringArrayVar(&set, "set", nil, "template variable, as KEY=VALUE")
        f.StringVar(&harnessArg, "harness", "installed", "installed, all, none, or comma-separated ids")
        f.StringSliceVar(&paths, "path", nil, "also install to this directory")
        f.StringSliceVar(&sources, "source", nil, "also read templates from this directory")
        f.BoolVar(&global, "global", false, "use ~/.agents and home directories")
        f.BoolVar(&copyIt, "copy", false, "copy instead of linking")
        f.BoolVar(&perHarness, "per-harness", false, "render a separate copy into each harness's own directory")
        f.BoolVar(&force, "force", false, "replace links; your own directories are never replaced")
        return cmd
}

package main

import (
        "context"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "net/http"
        "os"
        "os/signal"
        "syscall"
        "time"

        "github.com/spf13/cobra"
        "golang.org/x/term"

        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/realm"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/tui"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/vlog"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/pkg/observe"
)

func topCmd() *cobra.Command {
        var (
                interval     time.Duration
                once, asJSON bool
                noColor      bool
                forceColor   bool
                width        int
                viewName     string
                all          bool
        )
        cmd := &cobra.Command{
                Use:     "top",
                Aliases: []string{"dash", "dashboard"},
                Short:   "Live terminal dashboard: flow, throughput, latency, jitter, probes, liveness and usage",
                Long: `A live view of the swarm. Keys: 1-5 or tab switch views, arrows or j and k scroll,
p pauses, q quits.

Without a terminal, such as in a pipe, it prints one frame and exits.
Rates reset when the server restarts. Task states and usage totals do not.`,
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
                        if all {
                                return topAll(cmd, interval, once, asJSON, noColor, forceColor, width, viewName)
                        }
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return fmt.Errorf("%w; start it with: aiculator up", err)
                        }
                        fetch := func(ctx context.Context) (observe.Snapshot, error) {
                                var s observe.Snapshot
                                err := c.Get(ctx, "/v1/observe", &s)
                                return s, err
                        }
                        views := map[string]tui.View{"overview": tui.Overview, "tasks": tui.Tasks, "agents": tui.Agents, "flow": tui.Flow, "usage": tui.Usage}
                        view, ok := views[viewName]
                        if !ok {
                                return fmt.Errorf("unknown view %q: use overview, tasks, agents, flow or usage", viewName)
                        }
                        if asJSON {
                                s, err := fetch(cmd.Context())
                                if err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                                return printJSON(s)
                        }
                        color := !noColor && os.Getenv("NO_COLOR") == ""
                        tty := term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdin.Fd())) && term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdout.Fd()))
                        if once || !tty {
                                s, err := fetch(cmd.Context())
                                if err != nil {
                                        return err
                                }
                                w, _ := tui.ScreenSize(term.GetSize(int(os.Stdout.Fd())))
                                if width > 0 {
                                        w = width
                                }
                                fmt.Println(tui.Render(s, tui.Options{View: view, Width: w, Height: 60, Color: forceColor || (color && tty), Plain: true}))
                                return nil
                        }
                        // A log line on stderr would corrupt the screen, so logs go only to a file.
                        if logFile == "" {
                                vlog.SetOutput(io.Discard, logFormat)
                        }
                        ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(cmd.Context(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
                        defer stop()
                        return tui.Run(ctx, fetch, interval, color)
                },
        }
        f := cmd.Flags()
        f.DurationVar(&interval, "interval", time.Second, "how often to refresh")
        f.BoolVar(&all, "all", false, "show every realm on this machine: 1 realms, 2 tasks, 3 agents")
        f.BoolVar(&once, "once", false, "print one frame and exit")
        f.BoolVar(&asJSON, "json", false, "print the raw snapshot as JSON and exit")
        f.BoolVar(&noColor, "no-color", false, "no color; NO_COLOR also works")
        f.BoolVar(&forceColor, "color", false, "with --once: keep color even in a pipe")
        f.IntVar(&width, "width", 0, "with --once: width in columns")
        f.StringVar(&viewName, "view", "overview", "with --once: overview, tasks, agents, flow or usage")
        return cmd
}

func topAll(cmd *cobra.Command, interval time.Duration, once, asJSON, noColor, forceColor bool, width int, viewName string) error {
        if asJSON {
                views, err := realm.Gather(cmd.Context(), nil)
                if err != nil {
                        return err
                }
                return printJSON(views)
        }
        view := tui.View(0)
        switch viewName {
        case "overview", "realms":
        case "tasks":
                view = 1
        case "agents":
                view = 2
        default:
                return fmt.Errorf("unknown view %q with --all: use realms, tasks or agents", viewName)
        }
        color := !noColor && os.Getenv("NO_COLOR") == ""
        tty := term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdin.Fd())) && term.IsTerminal(int(os.Stdout.Fd()))
        if once || !tty {
                rows, err := fleet(cmd.Context())
                if err != nil {
                        return err
                }
                w, _ := tui.ScreenSize(term.GetSize(int(os.Stdout.Fd())))
                if width > 0 {
                        w = width
                }
                fmt.Println(tui.RenderFleet(rows, tui.Options{View: view, Width: w, Height: 60, Color: forceColor || (color && tty), Plain: true}))
                return nil
        }
        if logFile == "" {
                vlog.SetOutput(io.Discard, logFormat)
        }
        ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(cmd.Context(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
        defer stop()
        return tui.RunFleet(ctx, fleet, interval, color)
}

// eventsCmd streams every committed task change as JSON lines, so that any program in
// any language can follow the swarm without being compiled in.
func eventsCmd() *cobra.Command {
        return &cobra.Command{
                Use:   "events",
                Short: "Stream every task change as JSON lines",
                Example: `  aiculator events
  aiculator events | jq -r 'select(.state == "done") | .id'`,
                RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
                        c, err := adminClient()
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(cmd.Context(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
                        defer stop()
                        req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, c.URL+"/v1/events", nil)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+c.Token)
                        resp, err := c.HTTP.Do(req)
                        if err != nil {
                                return err
                        }
                        defer resp.Body.Close()
                        if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
                                return fmt.Errorf("server answered %s", resp.Status)
                        }
                        _, err = io.Copy(os.Stdout, resp.Body)
                        if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
                                return nil
                        }
                        return err
                },
        }
}

// Package api exposes the service over HTTP and MCP. It holds no state.
package api

import (
        "bytes"
        "context"
        "encoding/json"
        "errors"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "net/http"
        "net/url"
        "strconv"
        "strings"
        "time"

        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/auth"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/core"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/engine"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/meta"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/store"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/swarm"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/internal/vlog"
        "github.com/Grano22/aiculator/pkg/observe"
)

// Server holds what the handlers need.
type Server struct {
        S       *swarm.Service
        Auth    *auth.Authority
        Version string
        // Sync reports on and receives webhooks for connected systems, when configured.
        Sync SyncAPI
        // Instance identifies this server, so a client can tell it from another on the same port.
        Instance string
        // Term counts how many times a server has become leader for this data directory, so a
